nodes.label: Design: build-cooking-hub
nodes.description: Technical decisions, visual brief, contracts (schema, types, server functions, routes) and build notes

nodes.label: Empty bootstrap commit on main before the feature branch
nodes.rationale: Unrelated histories would need --allow-unrelated-histories; bootstrap makes main an ancestor

nodes.label: Images: sharp WebP downscale loop (≤1600 px, ≤200 KB)
nodes.rationale: URL import downloads images on the server, so client-side canvas downscaling alone would not cover it

nodes.label: Upload size: BODY_SIZE_LIMIT=16M, 15 MB check in browser and server
Markdown via markdown-it (html:false, validateLink http/https/mailto)
nodes.rationale: A DOM sanitiser (DOMPurify + jsdom) would allow safe inline HTML but costs a heavy dependency

nodes.label: Search via recipes.search_text = fold(title+description+ingredients+tags)
nodes.rationale: SQLite NOCASE folds ASCII only; JS toLowerCase folds umlauts

nodes.label: Parse on save; parse edited by editing the text
nodes.rationale: Per-field overrides would cost three more inputs per line

nodes.label: Import: fetch with timeout, JSON-LD and meta found by regex (no HTML parser)
Route layout: (app) group holds the nav; /__mockups and /__test outside
Server API style: load + form actions, writes only via src/lib/server/*.ts
nodes.rationale: No separate JSON API; DnD, favourite and check-off submit small forms programmatically

nodes.label: Archive state in the URL (?tags, fav, q, sort)
today() from the server clock, overridable in tests
Native HTML5 drag & drop (desktop only), Move to… as keyboard path
Shopping amounts as manual_amounts + plan_amounts parts
nodes.rationale: Gate 1 addition g: plan amounts merge into a manual item while keeping its manual part

nodes.label: Name keys: fold() + last word singularised
E2E isolation: one server, one DB, workers: 1, reset per test
nodes.rationale: One server+DB per project would halve suite time but needs a second port per unit

nodes.label: Motion primitives live in motion.ts; features add their own modules
Visual brief (UI-inspo reading, palette, type, components, motion set, alignment rule)
Palette: cream/sand ground, olive + brick accents, one dark tile, glass
Type: one serif display face + one sans text face (OFL, self-hosted)
Components: GlassPanel, PillNav, ArrowButton, RoundNav, Card, Chip, Button, Kicker, Counter, Tile, ImagePlaceholder
Motion set table (S7, S8, S15, S16, S18, S21, S22, S31)
Alignment rule: one centred 1200px column
Schema contract (tags, images, recipes, ingredient_lines, plan_entries, shopping_items, category_memory)
nodes.rationale: plan_entries.recipe_id has no ON DELETE action so a missed conversion in deleteRecipe fails loudly

nodes.label: Types contract (src/lib/types.ts)
Server function stubs and owners (U5–U19)
Unit table for parse.ts (g, kg, ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, …; families g/kg, ml/l)
Routes and owners table
RecipeForm + saveFromForm shared by manual form and import preview
Outro aria-hidden fix (Entry.svelte, 160 ms outro)
nodes.rationale: Only one "Save" may exist in the role tree during an outro

nodes.label: Shared hero view transition recipe-hero-<id>
nodes.rationale: Duplicate view-transition names make startViewTransition fail, so only the clicked card carries it
